Game Overview

Echolocation Shooter is a first-person shooter game built around blast through darkness using soundwave weapons that reveal your eerie surroundings. Navigate shadowy levels, battling neon foes with every shot, uncovering the battlefield. Upgrade, strategize, and survive endless enemy waves as each boom illuminates your path to victory. Prepare for a pulse-pounding, sensory-defying experience!
